items.prompt:
Which ruler is credited with strengthening Islam and central authority in Kanem-Bornu in the 16th century?

A) Sundiata Keita
B) Mai Idris Alooma
C) Mansa Musa
D) Sunni Ali

The council of kingmakers that checked the power of the Alaafin of Oyo was the:

A) Ogboni
B) Oyo Mesi
C) Aros
D) Nri

mcq_options.text: Internal disputes and the Fulani jihad

items.prompt:
A major cause of the decline of the Oyo empire in the 19th century was:

A) Internal disputes and the Fulani jihad
B) European colonisation of Lagos
C) The Atlantic charter
D) The Berlin Conference
items.correct_answer: A) Internal disputes and the Fulani jihad

items.prompt:

A) Crude oil

A) Mansa Musa

mcq_options.text: One of the few states never formally colonised by Europeans

items.prompt:
Liberia is notable in African history for being:

A) One of the few states never formally colonised by Europeans
B) The first British colony
C) A Portuguese trading fort
D) A French protectorate
items.correct_answer: A) One of the few states never formally colonised by Europeans
